title: A Light Like the Morning
traveler_why: Willow's gift is tenderness, and tonight Isaiah says tenderness is the fast Heavenly Father chose.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because tenderness is the fast Heavenly Father chose. In Willow's world today: Willow opens her lunch and finds two clementines. The girl beside her has none. Willow rolls one across the table without saying a word. Just like the people who shared their bread and watched their light rise, Willow learned that kindness is how a heart turns bright.
